Exhaustive exact TAR graph enumeration over n=3..8 and every 2<=k<=n+1 matches all component counts and special shapes. Finite checks are corroborative, not relied upon to establish arbitrary order.

value.rationale: An exact infinite-family component count decides reachability of dominating configurations at every size budget. It shows a polynomial-in-order explosion of frozen states at budget four, complete merging at budget five, and reentrant failure of connectivity caused by two whole sides at budget n for n>=6. This sharp two-mechanism phase diagram is nontrivial structural information not provided by the scalar domination number or the prior minimal-set enumerator.
